hook: Your offer letter template predates the labour codes. That is now a problem.
body:
Your offer letter template predates the labour codes. That is now a problem.

The central rules are notified. Wage definitions, night-shift consent and contracting paperwork all change.

Most firms above five hundred headcount have re-papered nothing.

This is not a legal department task.
It sits with whoever owns your offer template and your contractor agreements.

Start with the wage definition. Everything downstream inherits it.
first_comment_text: The KPMG summary of the notified central rules is a useful starting point for your review.

image_brief.subject: Layered paper documents on a wide desk, the topmost sheet noticeably newer than those beneath
image_brief.palette: warm neutral paper, soft daylight, one deep ink accent
